blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jaime T. Cruz, who was identified as an incorporator of the same businesses in which Vice President Sara Duterte declared having stocks, may also be called as a witness before the Senate Impeachment Court, House prosecution spokesperson Ace Barbers said Monday. Barbers made the statement after the conclusion of the 27th day of Duterte’s impeachment trial, during which Cruz’s name surfaced several times as the vice president’s Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) records were examined.
